epics.description: Establish and maintain governing scheme configuration, eligibility rules, status, effective dating, and auditability of material scheme changes.

stories.description: As a pension administrator, I want to register a scheme and configure its details, eligibility rules, status, and effective dates, so that enrollment, contributions, and benefits are applied against consistent, effective rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an authorized pension administrator, when a new scheme is created, then the scheme has identifiable details and a configuration record exists.
Given a scheme registration attempt, when no configuration exists, then the scheme record cannot be created without configuration.
Given a scheme record, when it is queried, then its identity is unique and no duplicate scheme record exists.

stories.summary: Define and store scheme eligibility rules
stories.description: As a pension administrator, I want to store scheme eligibility rules and make them available for enrollment validation, so that enrollments comply with applicable scheme rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Given eligibility rules are stored, when an enrollment is validated, then the validation references the stored rules.
Given a change to eligibility rules, when it is saved, then the change is recorded and traceable.
Given an enrollment attempt, when eligibility rules are unavailable, then the attempt is not silently approved.

stories.summary: Track scheme status and effective dates
stories.description: As a pension administrator, I want to track scheme status and effective dates for status and rule changes, so that downstream processing uses the correct rules for each period.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a scheme status change, when it is recorded with an effective date, then the status and effective date are visible on the scheme record.
Given a downstream process, when it runs against a scheme, then it applies the status and rules effective for that period.
Given a historical query, when it requests a past effective date, then the scheme state at that date is retrievable.

stories.description: As a compliance or management reviewer, I want material scheme changes to be recorded with actor, timestamp, and content, so that accountability for scheme configuration is provable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a material scheme change, when it is made, then an audit record is produced with actor, timestamp, and change content.
Given an audit query, when it filters by scheme and date range, then all material changes in that range are returned.
Given an audit record, when it is retrieved, then it cannot be altered without a new audit entry.

epics.description: Maintain authoritative employer identities, authorized contacts, and scheme associations so contributions can be attributed correctly.

stories.description: As a pension administrator or employer, I want to register and maintain employer records, so that contributions can be attributed to the correct employer.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an employer registration, when it is submitted, then the employer is recorded with identifiable details.
Given a registration attempt for an existing employer, when it is processed, then the duplicate is flagged.
Given an employer record, when it is updated by an authorized actor, then the change is recorded with actor and timestamp.

stories.description: As an employer, I want to maintain a set of authorized contacts for my employer record, so that only authorized contacts can act on my behalf.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an employer record, when a contact is added or changed, then the change is recorded and traceable.
Given an action on behalf of an employer, when the actor is not an authorized contact, then the action is rejected.
Given a request to view authorized contacts, when the requester is authorized, then the contact list is displayed.

stories.description: As a pension administrator or employer, I want to associate employers with their relevant schemes, so that contributions can be traced to the correct scheme.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an employer-scheme association, when a contribution is submitted by that employer, then it can be traced to the associated scheme.
Given an employer, when its scheme associations are queried, then all active associations are returned.
Given a contribution, when its employer-scheme association is missing, then it is flagged for resolution rather than silently completed.

epics.description: Enroll eligible members, maintain their records, and prevent duplicate or invalid registrations.

stories.summary: Enroll members through a controlled workflow
stories.description: As a pension administrator or member, I want to enroll members through a controlled workflow, so that enrollments are validated against scheme rules before being recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an enrollment submission, when it is processed, then it can be submitted, validated against scheme rules, and recorded.
Given an enrollment, when it is created, then it has a unique identity and is linked to its scheme.
Given an enrollment workflow, when it is in progress, then its status is visible to authorized users.

stories.description: As a pension administrator or operations personnel, I want enrollment to be validated against applicable scheme eligibility rules before recording, so that ineligible enrollments are prevented or routed to an exception.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an enrollment attempt, when it fails eligibility rules, then it is prevented or routed to an exception rather than silently approved.
Given a rejected enrollment, when it is reviewed, then the rejection reason is recorded.
Given an eligible enrollment, when it passes validation, then it proceeds to record creation.

stories.description: As a pension administrator or member, I want to maintain member records, so that member information stays accurate and changes are auditable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a member record change, when it is made by an authorized actor, then the change is recorded with actor and timestamp.
Given a member record, when it is queried, then its current information is displayed.
Given a historical query, when it requests a past member state, then the state at that date is retrievable.

stories.summary: Prevent duplicate and invalid member registrations
stories.description: As a pension administrator or operations personnel, I want duplicate or invalid member registrations to be detected and prevented, so that member records remain unique and valid.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a registration attempt for a potential duplicate, when it is processed, then the potential duplicate is flagged.
Given an invalid registration, when it is submitted, then it cannot be completed silently.
Given a duplicate detection, when it occurs, then the outcome (block, merge, or escalate) is recorded.

epics.description: Administer pension-account records and their associations with members and schemes, with clear traceability to relevant business records.

stories.description: As a pension administrator, I want to create and maintain pension-account records, so that each account has an identifiable record associated with a member and scheme.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an account creation, when it is completed, then the account has an identifiable record and is linked to a member and scheme.
Given an account record, when it is updated, then the change is recorded with actor and timestamp.
Given an account, when it is queried, then its associations are displayed.

stories.summary: Link accounts to members and schemes
stories.description: As a pension administrator, I want each pension account to be linked to its member and scheme, so that contributions and investments can be traced to the correct member and scheme.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an account, when its member and scheme links are queried, then they are returned.
Given a contribution or investment, when it references an account, then it can be traced to the relevant member and scheme.
Given an account, when its links are missing or inconsistent, then it is flagged for resolution.

stories.summary: Trace account activity to business records
stories.description: As a compliance or management reviewer, I want account activity to be traceable to submission, receipt, allocation, and investment records, so that account movements are fully auditable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an account activity record, when it is queried, then it links to the relevant submission, receipt, allocation, and investment records.
Given an audit query on an account, when it is run, then all linked business records within the period are returned.
Given an account activity, when it is retrieved, then it cannot be altered without a new audit entry.

epics.description: Record contribution submissions, receipts, and allocations; reconcile differences; and track exceptions to resolution.

stories.description: As an employer or pension administrator, I want to record contribution submissions, so that submitted amounts are traceable to the relevant employer, member, and scheme.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a contribution submission, when it is recorded, then it has identifiable employer, member, and scheme associations.
Given a submission, when it is queried, then its status and associations are displayed.
Given a submission, when it is modified, then the change is recorded with actor and timestamp.

stories.description: As a finance personnel, I want to record contribution receipts, so that received amounts can be distinguished from submissions and reconciled.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a contribution receipt, when it is recorded, then it is distinguished from submissions and linked to the relevant submission.
Given a receipt, when it is queried, then its source and format are visible.
Given a receipt, when it is updated, then the change is recorded with actor and timestamp.

stories.description: As a finance personnel, I want to record contribution allocations to pension accounts, so that allocated amounts are traceable to contributions, members, schemes, and accounts.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an allocation, when it is recorded, then it is associated with the relevant contribution, member, scheme, and account.
Given an allocation, when it is queried, then all associations are displayed.
Given an allocation, when it is modified, then the change is recorded with actor and timestamp.

stories.description: As a finance personnel, I want each contribution to be associated with the relevant employer, member, and scheme, so that contributions cannot be recorded without required associations.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a contribution, when it is recorded without required associations, then it is flagged for resolution rather than silently completed.
Given a contribution, when its associations are complete, then it is marked as fully associated.
Given an incomplete contribution, when it is queried, then the missing associations are displayed.

stories.summary: Reconcile submitted, received, and allocated amounts
stories.description: As a finance personnel, I want submitted, received, and allocated amounts to be reconciled with differences identified, so that financial transactions are reconcilable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a reconciliation run, when it is executed, then it reports submitted, received, and allocated totals with any differences.
Given a reconciliation, when it is queried, then its method and period are visible.
Given a difference, when it is identified, then it is flagged for resolution rather than silently cleared.

stories.description: As a finance or operations personnel, I want unmatched amounts, invalid records, and failed transactions to be flagged for resolution, so that they are not silently marked complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an unmatched amount, invalid record, or failed transaction, when it is detected, then it is flagged.
Given a flagged item, when it is queried, then its status and source records are displayed.
Given a flagged item, when it is resolved, then the resolution is recorded and the flag is cleared.

stories.description: As an operations or finance personnel, I want identified exceptions to be tracked through to resolution, so that unresolved exceptions remain visible until handled.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an exception, when it is created, then it has a status and a resolution record.
Given an unresolved exception, when it is queried, then it remains visible in exception listings.
Given a resolved exception, when it is queried, then the resolution details are displayed.

stories.summary: Preserve evidence of material financial actions
stories.description: As a compliance or management reviewer, I want material financial actions to be preserved in a traceable audit record, so that financial accountability is provable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a material financial action, when it occurs, then it is preserved in a traceable audit record.
Given an audit query on financial actions, when it is run, then the actor, timestamp, and content are returned.
Given an audit record, when it is retrieved, then it cannot be altered without a new audit entry.

epics.description: Maintain approved investment and allocation records with traceability of changes; trading, execution, and advice remain out of scope.

stories.summary: Maintain approved investment and allocation records
stories.description: As a pension administrator, I want to maintain approved investment and allocation records, so that investment positions are reliably recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an approved investment record, when it is created, then it can be maintained and queried.
Given an allocation record, when it is updated, then the change is recorded with actor and timestamp.
Given an investment record, when it is queried, then its approval status is displayed.

stories.description: As a compliance or management reviewer, I want changes to investment records to be recorded with actor, timestamp, and content, so that investment changes are traceable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an investment record change, when it is made, then it is recorded with actor, timestamp, and content.
Given an audit query on investment records, when it is run, then all changes within the period are returned.
Given an audit record, when it is retrieved, then it cannot be altered without a new audit entry.

epics.description: Record and validate benefit requests, route them for controlled review and approval, and record decisions and payment outcomes.

stories.description: As a member or pension administrator, I want benefit requests to be recorded and validated against confirmed rules, so that only compliant requests proceed.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a benefit request, when it is submitted, then it is recorded and validated against stored rules.
Given an invalid benefit request, when it is validated, then it is flagged for resolution rather than silently approved.
Given a valid benefit request, when it passes validation, then it proceeds to review.

stories.summary: Route benefit requests through controlled review and approval
stories.description: As a pension administrator or finance personnel, I want benefit requests to be routed through controlled review and approval steps with decisions recorded, so that sensitive benefit actions are properly authorized.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a benefit request, when it enters the workflow, then it is routed through review and approval steps.
Given a benefit request, when a decision is made, then the decision is recorded.
Given a sensitive benefit action requiring separation of duties, when it is attempted by a single actor, then the actor cannot complete all stages end-to-end.

stories.description: As a pension administrator or operations personnel, I want the processing status of benefit requests to be visible, so that I can monitor progress and identify delays.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a benefit request, when it is queried, then its current processing status is displayed.
Given a benefit request, when it moves to a new status, then the status change is recorded with timestamp.
Given a status query, when it filters by status, then only matching requests are returned.

stories.description: As a pension administrator or finance personnel, I want payment outcomes for benefit requests to be recorded and traced to the benefit decision, so that benefit payments are auditable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a benefit decision, when a payment outcome is recorded, then it is traced to the benefit decision.
Given a payment outcome, when it is queried, then the associated benefit request and decision are displayed.
Given a payment outcome, when it is updated, then the change is recorded with actor and timestamp.

epics.description: Provide operational and financial reporting with visibility into processing status, reconciliation discrepancies, and unresolved exceptions, supported by traceable records.

stories.description: As a pension administrator, operations personnel, or management, I want operational reports on pension administration activity, so that I can monitor day-to-day processing.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an operational report request, when it is generated, then it covers key pension administration activities.
Given an operational report, when it is queried, then its content and format are displayed.
Given an operational report, when it is regenerated for the same period, then the results are consistent.

stories.description: As a finance personnel or management, I want financial reports including contribution and reconciliation status, so that financial positions are visible and reconcilable.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a financial report, when it is generated, then it reflects submitted, received, allocated, and reconciled contribution amounts.
Given a financial report, when it is queried, then its period and content are displayed.
Given a financial report, when it is regenerated for the same period, then the results are consistent.

stories.summary: Provide visibility into discrepancies and exceptions
stories.description: As an operations, finance, or management user, I want visibility into processing status, reconciliation discrepancies, and unresolved exceptions, so that issues are identified and resolved promptly.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a discrepancy or unresolved exception, when it is queried, then it is visible in reporting or dashboards.
Given a dashboard, when it is loaded, then it displays current processing status, discrepancies, and unresolved exceptions.
Given a discrepancy, when it is resolved, then it is no longer shown as unresolved.

stories.summary: Retrieve audit records of material actions
stories.description: As a compliance or management reviewer, I want to retrieve traceable records of material actions and changes, so that audit and accountability reviews are supported.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an audit query, when it is run, then it returns who did what, when, and to which business record.
Given an audit record, when it is retrieved, then it cannot be altered without a new audit entry.
Given an audit query with filters, when it is run, then only matching records are returned.

stories.description: As a compliance or management reviewer, I want reports to be complete and consistent with underlying records, so that reported totals are trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a report and its underlying records for the same period, when they are compared, then the totals agree.
Given a report, when it is generated, then all records within the reporting period are included.
Given a discrepancy between a report and underlying records, when it is detected, then it is flagged for investigation.

epics.description: Enforce role-based access, controlled authorization of sensitive operations, and separation of submission, review, and approval functions.

stories.description: As a system administrator, I want role-based access to be enforced so that sensitive operations are restricted to authorized roles.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a user with a defined role, when they attempt an operation, then access is granted or denied based on their role.
Given a sensitive operation, when it is attempted by an unauthorized role, then it is denied.
Given a role definition, when it is updated, then access rights are applied immediately.

stories.description: As a system administrator, I want roles to be configurable so that submission, review, and approval functions can be separated for sensitive actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a role configuration, when it is saved, then the role can submit, review, or approve as defined.
Given a sensitive action requiring separation of duties, when a single actor attempts all stages, then the action is blocked.
Given a role change, when it is made, then the change is recorded with actor and timestamp.

stories.description: As a system administrator, I want access to sensitive operations to be controlled so that only authorized roles can perform them.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a sensitive operation, when it is accessed by an unauthorized role, then access is denied.
Given a sensitive operation, when it is performed by an authorized role, then the action is recorded.
Given a list of sensitive operations, when it is queried, then only authorized users can view it.
